mentions.note: cover photo; won Surrey League race at Lloyd Park on January 9th, first of two league wins; 34th in the National

mentions.h: League Record from Regis but the 'Valley' pip Bels — British Athletics League, Division 1 Match 3, Linford Christie Stadium, 2 Jul

photos.c: Front page: Through bushes and briars Matthew Hillier storms to the first of his two league wins, this one at a muddy Lloyd Park on January 9th. Matthew went on to place 34th in the "National".
